usedFor: AntsRoute holds delivery, service and collect orders, added with “Create Order” and moved to a date with “Schedule Order”.

bestTemplate.name: “Create Order” in AntsRoute
bestTemplate.why: It puts a service, delivery or collect into the planning on a date, so work is scheduled on creation.

watchOut: “Delete Order” can delete or archive an order, so check which option it uses before it runs.
